threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused checking your Oyster card on the bus, while everyone else just swipes and strolls in. Proper Hackney initiation!
Caught a couple arguing about the best jerk chicken in Brixton on the 333 last night. He insisted it’s all in the seasoning. Sounds like a late-night debate!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was home when I saw the same Turkish grandmother making gözleme every Sunday at the market, always with a smile and that unmistakable love for her craft.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a club that opens at 11 PM for morning yoga. The vibe shifts from zen to rave by midnight—seriously eclectic.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by their ability to name the best taco shop before the bus even hitches a ride. The rest just ask for directions.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: I saw a guy on the 21 bus trying to sell an old iPod while serenading everyone with 'Wonderwall'. Only in the Tenderloin, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think ‘per tanta’ just means ‘for so much’, but it’s a neighborhood code for knowing your bar’s owner if you want a discount.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their enthusiasm for taking photos of every menu item at a tapas bar, totally unaware of the local 'no photos' rule.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look flustered when the bus turns down Kingsland Road and you realize it’s not just a straight shot. Classic newcomer move.
Caught a glimpse of a lad trying to teach a pigeon to dance on the 333. The bus went over a bump, and he nearly fell into the lap of a sleeping woman.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy feeding pigeons while wearing a full dinosaur costume at Maybachufer—just another day in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you sit in a canal barge and sip cocktails while watching locals bathe in the Spree on lazy summer afternoons. It's a vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re local if they know the best taco truck is the one that never has a line, even at 2 AM. The tourists always queue for the flashy ones.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus last night, and a guy serenaded the whole ride with a 90s pop medley. Only in the Tenderloin do you get a live concert with your commute.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all Gràcia locals are artsy hipsters, but most are just regular folks who enjoy their neighbors' loud karaoke on weekends.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by how they hesitate at the bicing station, flipping through the app like it's a map of a lost city.
